review.official:
Nyamu Yūtenji, drummer of
Ave Mujica
. Frank and upfront, she plays an active role in supporting
Rhodes Island
's internal communications. She works with
Goldenglow
to help other operators with their makeup, a service that has earned her considerable approval.

files.description:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Nyamu Yūtenji shows no signs of Originium infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] Undisclosed
The Medical Department has agreed not to disclose the relevant data.

Nyamu Yūtenji demonstrated great curiosity about Rhodes Island the moment she set foot on the ship. Outside of work, she can often be seen studying Rhodes Island and Terra in the archives, always declining with a smile when asked if she's in need of any help. There are still many mysteries about her.

Nyamu is not just a very physically capable drummer; her bright and friendly personality has also made her many friends amongst the operators. Yet she is also highly observant, and sensitive to changes in other people's moods. By inferring what people are thinking based on their expression and body language, she is able to respond appropriately and maintain a positive atmosphere.
Everyone in the Medical Department recognizes how kind and gentle Nyamu is, though she is loath to admit it herself.

We thought it Nyamu's talent that allowed her to perform so well, both in her band and in her work at Rhodes Island.
It was only later that we learned it was not simply about talent, but the constant hard work that she puts in on her own. She is never satisfied, always pushing herself to move forward, as though the idea she could be at a standstill angers and terrifies her.
Hopefully, she will find the opportunity to slow down and take a little time off while she is on Rhodes Island.

Nyamu will spare no effort in pursuit of her dreams.
We have come to a hypothesis based on her actions and on excerpts of information from other Mujica members.
Nyamu is used to following the path that she believes to be most efficient, paying no heed to what other people think. Indeed, she could not even spare the time to think about whether she should give up or not.
In the presence of true genius, she found herself both awed and envious, and such emotions further fuel her fire.

[Iris's Notes]
Sailing for her goal in a straight line comes naturally to Nyamu, be it in dreams or reality; it is a notion she takes for granted.
It is fortunate, then, that she could rediscover the love she once abandoned.
She will not remember what transpired here when she wakes from the dream and returns to her old life, but she will continue to pursue her ideals. May a part of this dream stay with her and give her courage—
The courage to reach out to what she loves.
